items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Thad Jones–Mel Lewis – played with that band.

ctx.x: Yeah, from 1970 to 1979, which was thrilling all the time, because we did a lot of different things. We did trio. We did – augmented the trio into things like – we would do maybe five pieces, six pieces sometimes. We’d do big bands. We’d do symphonies. So there was a lot of different things that you could do, and we enjoyed all of them, because we enjoyed hearing her go through all of that. We played with Count Basie’s band. We played with Woody Herman’s band, Duke Ellington’s band, Jones and – what is it? I…
What was the trio that you mostly worked with, with her? Who were your bandmates?
